evidence: app/src/routes/abilities/ — self-contained route directory; no nav link to delete
app/src/routes/+layout.svelte:16-18 — nav only lists Pokémon and Types, so removing abilities needs no layout edit
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:90-97 — Abilities section on the Pokémon page must also be removed
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:90-98 — abilities list construction must be removed from the load too
app/src/app.css:505 — .plain-list used only by the abilities section (dead CSS after removal)
app/src/app.css:260 — .hidden-ability styles only used by ability cards
removability.rationale: The route itself deletes cleanly, but the spec-mandated Abilities section on the Pokémon page and two blocks of abilities-only CSS mean removal touches four files across three directories.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:124-141 — buildCards builds cards for the moves/abilities/type lists in one place, so one fix covers three pages
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:146-148 — spriteUrl is module-private, so it cannot be reused outside pokeapi.js
app/src/routes/+page.server.js:79 — home page re-derives the sprite media URL inline, duplicating pokeapi.js:147; a Deoxys-class sprite fix lands twice
app/src/routes/+page.server.js:76-88 — a second card shape built inline rather than via buildCard
app/src/lib/format.js — naming/flavor/missing-value rules single-sourced, so those fixes land once
changeability.rationale: Most fixes land in one obvious place (buildCards, format.js), but the home route duplicates sprite-URL and card construction, so sprite/shape bugs must be fixed in two unrelated files with nothing linking them.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:1-141 — all API access, base URL and caching behind narrow server-only functions; Kit enforces the src/lib/server boundary regardless of the #lib alias
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:21 — getApiBase exported only so a route can build a media URL itself
app/src/routes/+page.server.js:79 — route reaches into data-layer internals (API base + media path) instead of using a shared helper
app/src/lib/components/PokemonCard.svelte:5 — contract mixes props (showTypes, hidden) with the pokemon object; hidden duplicates data already on pokemon.hidden
app/src/routes/abilities/[name]/+page.svelte:17 — hidden={pokemon.hidden} passed explicitly while moves/types pages pass nothing, an inconsistent calling convention
app/src/app.css:210 — .pokemon-card styles live ~200 lines from the markup in PokemonCard.svelte; all styling is one global sheet instead of scoped styles
coupling.rationale: Server/client separation and component props are clean, but the data-layer seam leaks (inline media URL in a route), the PokemonCard contract is defined in two places, and every component's styles live in a distant global stylesheet.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:124-141 — buildCards stretches over two ref shapes (item.pokemon ?? item) and hidden-ability marking without flags
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:6-18 — memo is a single caching seam all fetchers share
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:33-58 — getRecord/getByUrl/getList are resource-generic and would serve an Items section unchanged
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:8-17 — columns derived from a table object (hasLevel) rather than move-specific props
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:150-166 — hiddenCard is a near-clone of buildCard (copy-paste)
app/src/lib/components/PokemonCard.svelte:5 — mild boolean-flag creep (showTypes, hidden)
abstraction_design.rationale: The data layer and MoveTable are designed around the app's real variation and would stretch to Items with little copying; the blemishes are the duplicated card builder pair and two flag props on PokemonCard.

findings.issue: Sprite media URL hand-built inline, duplicating the module-private spriteUrl in app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:146-148; the two are not connected in any way, so a sprite-source change or bug fix must be made twice and can drift.
findings.suggestion: Export a pokemonSprite(id) (or mediaUrl(path)) helper from the data layer and use it in both buildCard and the home load.

findings.issue: The Pokémon-card shape is built twice: buildCard/hiddenCard here (near-identical clones of each other) and an inline object literal with a different field set at app/src/routes/+page.server.js:76-88, so changes to the card (sprite, sort key, new field) touch two producers.
findings.suggestion: Keep one exported card builder (buildCard(id, speciesName, {types, hidden})) that both buildCards and the home load call, with types supplied by the caller.

findings.issue: Component contract mixes boolean flags with data it already receives: hidden is a separate prop even though pokemon.hidden exists on the data, and abilities page passes hidden={pokemon.hidden} while other callers pass nothing — an easy place for an inconsistent call.
findings.suggestion: Read pokemon.hidden inside the card; keep showTypes as the only prop (or accept a types array that home can supply).

findings.issue: All styling, including component- and page-specific rules (.pokemon-card:210, .filters:168, .move-table), lives in one ~708-line global stylesheet, so editing a component means editing a file far from its markup and deleting a feature leaves dead CSS.
findings.suggestion: Move component styles into scoped <style> blocks (PokemonCard, MoveTable) and route styles into their +page.svelte, keeping tokens/base rules global.

findings.issue: The 'cards section' markup (count intro + ul.card-grid + PokemonCard each) is copy-pasted verbatim in four routes (moves:53-57, abilities/[name]:20-23, types/[name]:35-39, home +page.svelte:112-116).
findings.suggestion: Extract a PokemonCardList component or snippet that takes the cards array and renders the count, list and per-card flags once.

findings.issue: Type-badge link markup (class=`type-badge type-${name}` + href=/types/name) is repeated in five files (PokemonCard.svelte:15, MoveTable.svelte:93, pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:49, types/[name]/+page.svelte:22, moves/[name]/+page.svelte:19).
findings.suggestion: Extract a TypeBadge component (or a snippet shared from a module) used everywhere a type link is rendered.

findings.issue: The file is only a placeholder comment; the `#lib` → index.js mapping declared in app/package.json imports is dead weight.
findings.suggestion: Delete the file and the `#lib` entry (keep `#lib/*`), or make index.js re-export the public helpers.

findings.issue: hiddenCard duplicates buildCard except for one boolean; the two can diverge silently.
findings.suggestion: Replace hiddenCard with buildCard(id, speciesName, hidden) or spread a {hidden} override.

summary: A conventionally structured, idiomatic SvelteKit 3 app with a genuinely reusable server-side data layer, so most cross-page changes land in one place. The recurring cost is the Pokémon card: its shape, sprite URL and section markup each exist twice (buildCards vs the inline home-page builder), which is exactly where the Deoxys-sprite and sorting scenarios bite. Everything else — URL-driven filter state, server/client separation, Kit-3 config in vite.config.js — is clean and current.
